candidate_sources.name: PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection
candidate_sources.license_evidence: Repository LICENSE.txt explicitly specifies Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Public License (SPDX: CC-BY-4.0).
candidate_sources.attribution_requirements: Mandatory citation of original paper: 'Singh, D., Jain, N., Jain, P., Kayal, P., Kumawat, S., & Batra, N. (2020). PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection. In Proceedings of the 7th ACM IKDD CoDS and 25th COMAD.'
candidate_sources.environment: Real-world field conditions (natural sunlight, complex background, varied angles)
candidate_sources.image_format: JPEG / PNG (Cropped images in train/test splits, object detection bounding boxes in companion repo)
candidate_sources.file_size_approx: 955 MB (git repository size reported by GitHub API)
tomato_classes_present: Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf
candidate_sources.download_method: git clone --depth 1 or GitHub zip archive
known_limitations_and_legal_risks: CRITICAL IP WARNING: Images were scraped from public internet image searches (Google Images) and annotated by researchers. The repository CC-BY-4.0 license covers the collection and bounding-box annotations, but third-party image-level copyrights remain unresolved. Suitable for academic benchmarking and evaluation; commercial deployment requires independent image clearance.
Class imbalance across species (e.g., some classes have <50 images).
Tomato Target Spot (Corynespora cassiicola) is absent from PlantDoc tomato classes.
'Tomato leaf yellow virus' is not genetically confirmed specifically as TYLCV Begomovirus.

candidate_sources.name: Tomato Leaf Dataset: A dataset for multiclass disease detection and classification (Bangladesh 2025)
candidate_sources.declared_license: CC-BY-4.0 (Mendeley metadata) / Research-only ethical constraint (Companion paper)
candidate_sources.license_evidence: Mendeley Data schema.org JSON-LD tags dataset as CC BY 4.0. Companion Data in Brief peer-reviewed paper (Elsevier, DOI: 10.1016/j.dib.2025.111520) declares CC-BY 4.0 for article.
candidate_sources.attribution_requirements: Citation: 'Imtiaz, Ahmed; Islam Swapnil, Fahad Bin; Masud, Syed Rayhan; Karmaker, Debajoyti (2025). Tomato Leaf Dataset: A dataset for multiclass disease detection and classification. Mendeley Data, v2, https://doi.org/10.17632/bpfd9cns5g.2'
candidate_sources.environment: Authentic agricultural open fields in Dinajpur, Thakurgaon, and Kushtia, Bangladesh
candidate_sources.image_format: JPG (Canon EOS M50 captures, resized to 640x640) + TXT YOLO format
tomato_classes_present: Category Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria)
known_limitations_and_legal_risks: DUAL-TERM CONFLICT: While Mendeley metadata specifies CC BY 4.0, Section 5 (Ethics Statement) of the peer-reviewed paper explicitly states: 'The aim was to advance knowledge in agricultural disease detection and management, not for commercial exploitation, and the data is intended for research purposes only.' Commercial applications must strictly respect this non-commercial restriction or obtain written author dispensation.
Single-crop dataset (Tomato only; does not cover multi-plant roadmap directly, but validates tomato subset).
Does not include viral classes (TYLCV or ToMV). Includes regional 'Black Spot' which is not in standard PlantVillage 38-class taxonomy.

candidate_sources.name: Tomato Leaf Image Dataset for Disease Analysis in Real-World Environment
candidate_sources.license_evidence: Mendeley Data schema.org JSON-LD explicitly specifies CC BY 4.0.
candidate_sources.attribution_requirements: Citation: 'Oni, Mangsura Kabir; Prama, Tabia Tanzin (2024). Tomato Leaf Image Dataset for Disease Analysis in Real-World Environment. Mendeley Data, v1, https://doi.org/10.17632/rnbsw72zb5.1'
candidate_sources.environment: Real-world agricultural fields in Bangladesh with complex backgrounds
candidate_sources.image_format: JPG + TXT region annotations (868 train, 160 validation split 80/80)
known_limitations_and_legal_risks: CRITICAL TAXONOMY LIMITATION: The dataset provides ONLY binary classification labels ('H' vs 'D'). It does NOT label specific disease pathologies (no early blight, late blight, leaf mold, or virus distinctions).
Cannot be used for multi-class disease diagnosis. Useful solely for Stage-1 binary health filtering or leaf detection.

candidate_sources.name: Tomato Leaf Disease Classification Dataset in Pakistan
candidate_sources.license_evidence: Mendeley Data schema.org JSON-LD explicitly specifies CC BY 4.0.
candidate_sources.attribution_requirements: Citation: 'Malik, Mohammad Naeem; Ali, Syed Hashir; Ali, Hamid (2026). Tomato Leaf Disease Classification Dataset in Pakistan. Mendeley Data, v2, https://doi.org/10.17632/3mbnb82mxd.2'
candidate_sources.environment: Real agricultural open fields in Pakistan, smartphone cameras under natural lighting without controlled backgrounds
candidate_sources.download_status: Planned / High Priority for Field Benchmark
known_limitations_and_legal_risks: Covers 6 of the 10 target tomato classes (Bacterial Spot, Target Spot, Mosaic Virus, Spider Mites are absent).
Requires verification of whether the 7,200 images represent unique photographic specimens or augmented variations.
Regional agro-climatic focus on Pakistan field conditions.

candidate_sources.name: PlantVillage Benchmark Dataset
candidate_sources.license_evidence: PlantVillage dataset was released by Penn State researchers into the public domain under CC0 1.0.
candidate_sources.attribution_requirements: Citation: 'Hughes, D. P., & Salathé, M. (2015). An open access repository of images on plant health to enable the development of mobile disease diagnostics. arXiv preprint arXiv:1511.08060.'
candidate_sources.environment: Laboratory indoor setting; clipped leaves mounted on flat monochrome paper sheets (gray/black/white)
candidate_sources.download_status: Baseline model already trained on this source
known_limitations_and_legal_risks: FATAL FIELD DOMAIN SHIFT: Severe background shortcut learning. Models learn paper texture and lab illumination rather than foliar disease biology, resulting in near-total diagnostic failure on real field photos.
Severe near-duplicate photo leakage across random splits.
Severe class imbalance (e.g. TYLCV has 3,209 images vs Mosaic Virus 373 images).

candidate_sources.name: Rice Leaf Disease Image Dataset for Indian Agricultural Agro-Climates
candidate_sources.attribution_requirements: Citation: 'Rahman, C. R., et al. (2020). A dataset of high-resolution rice disease images collected from real agricultural fields.'
candidate_sources.environment: Real paddy field conditions in South Asian agricultural zones
known_limitations_and_legal_risks: Single crop (Paddy/Rice only). Requires integration into multi-plant taxonomy framework.
Different leaf aspect ratio (long, narrow monocotyledonous blade) requires specialized tile/center-crop preprocessing compared to dicotyledonous leaves.
